deciding.fast_track_met: Jaundice with raised ALT is not a listed criterion: no iron deficiency anaemia, FIT or dysphagia is recorded.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Information is adequate for a booking and no fast-track feature is confirmed. An open episode at another hospital keeps routine acceptance only leaning.
deciding.first_contact: A direct test could be booked for jaundice with raised ALT. An advice letter is also plausible because Northside already has an open episode and no results are attached.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Jaundice over 2 weeks is an unexplained red flag, with rapid onset and no results explaining it.
deciding.record_agreement: Reason_text puts the Northside visit on 10 Jun, but history dates the ED visit 2024-06-11. This is a one-day difference that is trivial or arguably none.
